notes.title: Check out the VR Strategy Bundle
notes.content:
If you like Skylight, you might want to consider the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/4297/The_VR_Strategy_Bundle_Get_3_great_Vive_games/]VR Strategy Bundle[/url][/b]! Get 3 strategy games from the same developer at a discount. In addition to Skylight, you can get two award-winning VR titles: Darknet, a cyberpunk hacking game, and Tactera, a virtual tabletop RTS. 

Also, Skylight has been updated with a non-VR version and an Oculus Rift version, so it now supports the HTC Vive, Rift, and non-VR versions alike!
